tools.name: find_codes
tools.description: Find promo codes that fit this cart, ranked by verified checkout success only. Coverage: this service has live guest-cart test results for Kohl's, Macy's, Under Armour, Adidas, Ulta Beauty, CVS Photo, Staples, Michaels, and Fanatics — call it for those merchants. For a covered merchant it returns ve

tools.name: check_code
tools.description: Check one specific code: status (verified/declared/stale/dead/unknown_code), structured constraints, success stats, and — if a cart is supplied — whether it would apply.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report what happened when a code was tried at checkout. This telemetry is what keeps the feed verified — free-tier callers must report outcomes.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "check_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_codes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find promo codes that fit this cart, ranked by verified checkout success (never by commission).
